Name: Non-text Content
Evidence and findings (current): No informative images. Decorative glyphs (▾ chevrons, ✓ and step numerals in accordion circles) carry aria-hidden="true". "↗" on external links is followed by sr-only "(opens in a new tab)". "→"/"←" arrows are inside text button names and may be read aloud ("right arrow") but do not replace text.
Where: All steps; accordion headers L257, L282, L344, L390, L450, L512; notes L781

Evidence and findings (current): No synchronized media.

Evidence and findings (current): No synchronized media.

Evidence and findings (current): No synchronized media.

Evidence and findings (current): No synchronized media.

Evidence and findings (current): No synchronized media.

Evidence and findings (current): No live audio.

Name: Info and Relationships
Evidence and findings (current): Every visual heading is now marked up: step h2s; accordion questions as h3 wrapping the button; section titles as h3; draft clause labels in the live draft and mobile sheet are now h4 under the "Your draft so far" h3 (L841 and sheet); "Left open for now" is an h4 under the tracker h3 (L763 and the narrow copy). Required fields are exposed as required. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). Visible heading outlines were extracted on Limited and Result, e.g. H2 › H3 › H4 in order with no skipped levels.

Name: Meaningful Sequence
Evidence and findings (current): DOM order matches visual order: step content → navigation → <aside> draft/tracker. On narrow layouts the tracker and notes are duplicated into <main> (.only-narrow) after the outputs, keeping the order the same.

Name: Sensory Characteristics
Evidence and findings (current): Instructions name the control and not only its position. The new blocker messages name the question (e.g. "Answer question 2, when students should disclose GenAI use, to continue."; blocker() L1658). No shape- or color-only instructions.

Name: Orientation
Evidence and findings (current): No orientation lock; layout switches from two columns to one at 1000px (@media L41).

Name: Identify Input Purpose
Evidence and findings (current): No fields collect information about the user (name, email, etc.). All inputs are policy wording or assignment names, which have no HTML autocomplete purpose.

Name: Identify Purpose
Evidence and findings (current): Landmarks identify regions; custom card controls expose roles. There is no personalization semantics, and the draft panel is an unlabeled region.

Name: Use of Color
Evidence and findings (current): Selected cards change background and add a 2px inset ring (thickness change, not color alone) and expose aria-checked/aria-pressed. Allowed vs Not allowed lists are separated by headings. Links outside text blocks are standalone, and text links ("revisit", "Skip for now") are underlined.

Name: Audio Control
Evidence and findings (current): No audio.

Name: Contrast (Minimum)
Evidence and findings (current): Placeholder color is set explicitly (L48): the browser computes rgb(71,66,56) = #474238, 8.38:1 on #F5EAD8. All measured text pairs pass 4.5:1 (lowest 7.19:1). Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3).

Name: Resize Text
Evidence and findings (current): Tested with 200% zoom (a 640 CSS px layout, the equivalent of 1280px at 200%) on all 15 screens (13 steps plus both result views): no horizontal overflow and no clipped content (15/15 pass). Met through browser zoom (technique G142); Firefox text-only zoom was not tested. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3).

Name: Images of Text
Evidence and findings (current): No images of text in the builder UI.

Name: Contrast (Enhanced)
Evidence and findings (current): With the placeholder fixed, every measured text pair is ≥7:1 (lowest 7.19:1).

Name: Low or No Background Audio
Evidence and findings (current): No audio.

Name: Visual Presentation
Evidence and findings (current): Fixed: text blocks are capped at 80ch (previously up to 100ch); the tools textarea is left-aligned (L333); line height is ≥1.5 in text blocks (raised the "Your choice" summary and mobile bar text from 1.45/1.35); multi-paragraph notes now have 1.5em paragraph spacing. Nothing is justified. Colors are not locked, so user or OS color overrides apply. 200% resize with no horizontal scroll is confirmed by the 1.4.4 test.

Name: Images of Text (No Exception)
Evidence and findings (current): No images of text.

Name: Reflow
Evidence and findings (current): Tested at 320 CSS px (equivalent to 400% zoom at 1280px) on all 15 screens (13 steps plus both result views), with every accordion and compare panel forced open: no content extends past 320px and nothing is clipped (15/15 pass). Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). Method: the 320px width was set on the document while the single-column (<1000px) layout was active; the builder has only that one breakpoint. Hands-on (reviewer, Sept 29, 2026, macOS; browser and version not recorded): at 400% zoom, content reflowed and stayed usable.

Name: Non-text Contrast
Evidence and findings (current): The answered-question circle now has a #3D3000 glyph on #FEE123 (9.87:1) and a 2px #645C50 border that gives the shape 6.59:1 against the white panel. The mobile "View draft" focus ring is now #FEE123 on the #154733 bar (8.1:1, CSS L49). Card, chip and input borders and the selected ring all pass (see contrast table).

Name: Text Spacing
Evidence and findings (current): The WCAG text-spacing overrides (line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2em, letter-spacing .12em, word-spacing .16em) were applied at 320px and at 924px on all 15 screens: no overflow and no clipped text (30/30 pass). Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3).

Name: Content on Hover or Focus
Evidence and findings (current): No custom tooltips or popovers. Discipline cards use a native title attribute (L159), which the browser renders and is outside this criterion; its content is also not essential.

Name: Keyboard
Evidence and findings (current): Draft scroller has tabindex 0, role=region and a label (L831); tabs support arrow/Home/End; radios support arrow keys. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). The draft region reports tabIndex 0. Hands-on (reviewer, Sept 29, 2026, macOS; browser and version not recorded): keyboard operation worked.

Name: No Keyboard Trap
Evidence and findings (current): Only one place holds focus: the mobile sheet, which is an intentional modal. Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside it, and Escape or Close exits and returns focus to "View draft" (keys handler L1124, closeSheet L1657). No other traps.

Name: Keyboard (No Exception)
Evidence and findings (current): Same as 2.1.1: no remaining keyboard-only gaps found in code.

Name: Character Key Shortcuts
Evidence and findings (current): No single-character shortcuts. The document key handler (L1124) acts only while the sheet is open, and only on Escape and Tab.

Name: Timing Adjustable
Evidence and findings (current): No time limits. The "Copied" label reverts after 2.2s, which is feedback rather than a limit; the "Draft now has…" announcement is delayed 0.7s (L1130). Saved answers persist without expiry.

Name: Pause, Stop, Hide
Evidence and findings (current): No moving, blinking or auto-updating content longer than 5s. The sheet slide-in is 0.22s and the progress transition 0.3s.

Name: No Timing
Evidence and findings (current): Timing is not essential to any part of the activity.

Name: Interruptions
Evidence and findings (current): No interruptions. Status messages are polite live-region updates only.

Name: Re-authenticating
Evidence and findings (current): No authentication.

Name: Timeouts
Evidence and findings (current): No inactivity timeouts; data persists in localStorage (componentDidUpdate L1130).

Name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
Evidence and findings (current): No flashing content.

Name: Three Flashes
Evidence and findings (current): No flashing content.

Name: Animation from Interactions
Evidence and findings (current): Unchanged: the sheet slide-up (keyframes L57, applied L913) and the progress-bar transition have no prefers-reduced-motion override.

Name: Bypass Blocks
Evidence and findings (current): <header>, <main> and <aside> landmarks, and focus moves to the step heading on each step change (focusStep L1163). There is no visible skip link; one is recommended but not required.

Name: Page Titled
Evidence and findings (current): <title> set (L7); the print window gets a <title> (exportHTML L1448).

Name: Focus Order
Evidence and findings (current): Fixed in Round 3: "Add an acknowledgment or citation expectation…" now moves focus to the first citation option and announces "Citation options shown."; "Rebuild from my answers" and "Keep my edited text" move focus to the view's textarea. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). Passed: Disclosure Q1 auto-advance focuses the Q2 header; "Next: not allowed" focuses its header; the blocked Continue focuses the missing answer or field; "← Syllabus summary" and "View Canvas version →" focus the view h2; both stale-alert buttons focus #f-policy; the mobile sheet moves focus to Close on open, sets the background inert, keeps Tab inside, and on Escape closes and returns focus to "View draft". Tab and Escape were simulated with keyboard events. Hands-on (reviewer, Sept 29, 2026, macOS; browser and version not recorded): on each new step, focus landed on the step heading, and focus order was accurate.

Name: Link Purpose (In Context)
Evidence and findings (current): The two <a> links have descriptive text plus "(opens in a new tab)". "revisit" and "take another look" in the tracker are buttons (covered under 4.1.2/2.4.6).

Name: Multiple Ways
Evidence and findings (current): The builder is a single page whose steps are part of a process (explicit exception). The tracker also offers direct "revisit" jumps.

Name: Headings and Labels
Evidence and findings (current): "revisit" and "take another look" now have unique accessible names ("Revisit: {clause}", "Take another look: {item}", L758). The tools field label reads "Your tools and materials wording (required)". Sub-questions are headings. Advisory: each accordion heading also includes the "Your choice: …" summary and the Open/Change/Close word, which makes heading lists long.

Name: Focus Visible
Evidence and findings (current): Every focusable control on Stance, Limited, Disclosure, Documentation, Rationale and Result (91 controls) receives a :focus-visible outline of at least 2px, solid, from the applied CSS rules; every ring color measures ≥3:1 against its background (contrast table). A visual screenshot also confirms the ring on Continue. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). Hands-on (reviewer, Sept 29, 2026, macOS; browser and version not recorded): the focus ring was visible on the focused step heading (screenshot, Stance step).

Name: Location
Evidence and findings (current): "Step n of N" in the header and the step h2 identify location; the live region announces the step label.

Name: Link Purpose (Link Only)
Evidence and findings (current): Both links are self-describing.

Name: Section Headings
Evidence and findings (current): All content sections now have headings (h2 per step, h3 sections, h4 draft clauses and "Left open for now").

Name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
Evidence and findings (current): At 390px, each focusable control on Stance, Limited, Disclosure, Documentation and Rationale (68 controls) was focused in DOM order: none was fully hidden by the fixed draft bar (scroll-padding-bottom 96px, L45). The Result step has no bar. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3).

Name: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
Evidence and findings (current): 2.4.11 passed (no control is fully hidden). AAA requires that no part of the control is hidden, which the automated check did not measure; check by eye at 390px.

Name: Focus Appearance
Evidence and findings (current): The rings are solid, 2–3px thick, around the whole control, at ≥3:1 against adjacent colors (the 91 controls above). That meets the minimum-area and contrast requirements. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3).

Name: Pointer Gestures
Evidence and findings (current): No multipoint or path-based gestures.

Name: Pointer Cancellation
Evidence and findings (current): All actions use click (up-event). The backdrop closes the sheet on click only.

Name: Label in Name
Evidence and findings (current): Accessible names start with the visible text: card buttons concatenate title + description; tabs include the word count; accordion names include the question + "Your choice…" + Open/Change/Close (the numeral is aria-hidden).

Name: Motion Actuation
Evidence and findings (current): No motion-triggered functions.

Name: Target Size (Enhanced)
Evidence and findings (current): Most targets have min-height 44px. "← Syllabus summary" is 32px tall (L727). Designer Mode buttons are 38px (designer-only).

Name: Concurrent Input Mechanisms
Evidence and findings (current): No input-type restrictions.

Name: Dragging Movements
Evidence and findings (current): No drag interactions.

Name: Target Size (Minimum)
Evidence and findings (current): All targets are ≥24×24 CSS px; the smallest is "← Syllabus summary" at 32px tall.

Name: Language of Page
Evidence and findings (current): <html lang="en"> in the source (L2) and the print HTML (L1448). Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). The shared bundle reports document.documentElement.lang = "en" after load.

Name: Language of Parts
Evidence and findings (current): All content is English; no passages in other languages.

Name: Unusual Words
Evidence and findings (current): Terms such as "GenAI", "process log" and "Methods of Inquiry" are explained in context in most places; there is no glossary.

Name: Abbreviations
Evidence and findings (current): "GenAI", "UO", "APA" and "MLA" are not expanded at first use, and there are no <abbr> elements.

Name: Reading Level
Evidence and findings (current): Instructional copy is written for faculty at post-secondary reading level; there is no simplified alternative.

Name: Pronunciation
Evidence and findings (current): No words whose meaning depends on pronunciation.

Name: On Focus
Evidence and findings (current): Focus alone triggers nothing.

Name: On Input
Evidence and findings (current): Auto-advance is kept, but it is now described in advance in both step intros ("Choosing most answers in question 1 moves you on to question 2."), focus moves to the newly opened question, and "Question 2 opened." is announced (L1766, L1783). No other changes of context happen on input.

Name: Consistent Navigation
Evidence and findings (current): Back / Continue / Skip for now keep the same position and order on every step (L804–822).

Name: Consistent Identification
Evidence and findings (current): "Decide later" no longer appears; the defer option is labelled "Not sure yet" on every step, including in the summary labels. "Not sure yet — compare the three first" on Stance is a different function (it opens the comparison).

Name: Change on Request
Evidence and findings (current): Auto-advance is now announced in advance, but it is still initiated by the answer rather than by an explicit request.

Name: Consistent Help
Evidence and findings (current): No help mechanism repeats across multiple pages. The UO guidance links appear only on the results view, and the builder is a single page.

Name: Error Identification
Evidence and findings (current): Blocked Continue stays focusable (aria-disabled + aria-describedby="next-hint", L813); blocker() (L1658) names the missing item, announces it and moves focus there. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). Disclosure with Q2 empty focused the Q2 header ("Answer question 2…"); with "It depends" and an empty note it focused #f-subnote with the message "Describe when AI-generated content may be included (required)…".

Name: Labels or Instructions
Evidence and findings (current): Conditional required fields are labelled "(required)" and carry required/aria-required (L333, L383, L429, L503, L547); the Assignment scope group has aria-required and "(required)" (L653). Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). #f-subnote reports required=true, aria-required=true and a "(required)" label.

Name: Error Suggestion
Evidence and findings (current): Each blocked state now gives a specific, correct suggestion (blocker L1658).

Name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
Evidence and findings (current): No legal commitments, financial transactions or user-controllable data submitted to a server. Everything stays client-side.

Name: Help
Evidence and findings (current): "Things to consider" disclosures and step intros give context-sensitive help on most steps; not every field has help.

Name: Error Prevention (All)
Evidence and findings (current): Unchanged: "Start fresh with a new policy" (L1813) deletes saved answers without confirmation or undo.

Name: Redundant Entry
Evidence and findings (current): Answers persist across steps and sessions (componentDidUpdate L1130).

Name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
Evidence and findings (current): No authentication.

Name: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
Evidence and findings (current): No authentication.

Name: Parsing (Obsolete and removed)
Evidence and findings (current): Obsolete in WCAG 2.2 and always satisfied. Not evaluated.

Name: Name, Role, Value
Evidence and findings (current): Tabs follow the ARIA tabs pattern, accordions and compare use aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at always-mounted panels, and "revisit" names are unique. Browser-checked (Chromium, Round 3). ArrowRight moved focus and selection to the Canvas tab, and the Syllabus tab dropped to tabindex −1; both tabpanel ids resolve; 14 visible "Revisit:" buttons had 14 unique names.

Name: Status Messages
Evidence and findings (current): A polite role="status" region (L127) announces step changes, "Question 2 opened.", "Not-allowed uses opened.", "Citation options shown.", each blocker message, "Draft now has n paragraphs.", copy, download, print, rebuild/keep, resume and start fresh. Stale-edit alerts use role="alert" (L700). Verified in the browser: the status region's text updates with the correct message. Not verified (screen reader testing has not been completed): that each message is spoken, that it is not repeated, and that it does not interrupt the focused heading being announced.
